'''The southern gate''' of [[Livien Magnus]] was the primary entrance to [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] on its south side. It was assaulted by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] during the [[Battle of Ord Radama]] in [[3660 BBY]].<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side" />
